master.subtitle: Configure leave types available for your organization.
master.empty: Add leave types such as Casual Leave, Sick Leave, or Earned Leave.

policy.subtitle: Define rules for each leave type — notice period, limits, and eligibility.
policy.empty: Create policies to control how employees can apply for each leave type.

allocation.subtitle: Allocate annual leave balance to employees by leave type.
allocation.empty: Allocate leave balances for employees at the start of the year or on joining.

entitlement.subtitle: Set allocated days by leave type for a financial year.
entitlement.empty: Add entitlement to set leave allocation for a financial year.

requisition.subtitle: Apply for leave. New applications are saved as Pending.
requisition.empty: No leave requisitions yet. Apply with leave type, dates, and reason.
requisition.editAdmin: Update a pending leave requisition for the selected employee.
requisition.subtitleAdmin: Select branch and employee, then apply leave. New applications are saved as Pending.
requisition.subtitleUser: Apply for leave. Your employee profile is used automatically. New applications are saved as Pending.

application.subtitle: Employees can apply for leave via web or mobile with supporting documents.
application.empty: Submit a leave application with leave type, dates, reason, and optional document.

approval.subtitle: Review pending leave requests. Approve or reject from the Action column.
approval.empty: No pending leave applications in the approval queue.

calendar.subtitle: View approved and planned leave across the organization by month.
calendar.empty: Leave calendar entries will show who is on leave and when.

encashment.subtitle: Request encashment of unused eligible leave balance.
encashment.empty: Submit encashment requests for leave types marked as encashable in Leave Master.

approvalDialog.approveMessage: Approve {name}? You can add an optional note.
approvalDialog.rejectMessage: Reject {name}? A rejection reason is mandatory.

entitlementModal.subtitle: Set allocated days by leave type for the selected financial year.
entitlementModal.leaveTypesHint: Default days come from Leave Master. Adjust allocated days before saving.
entitlementModal.noLeaveTypes: No active leave types found in Leave Master.
entitlementModal.noTypes: No leave types available to allocate.
